name: PlanWise Floor Planner
author: claimpro

sections.description:
Stop wrestling with rulers and calculators! PlanWiseWP is a revolutionary, easy-to-use WordPress plugin that embeds a professional floor plan editor directly into your site with a simple shortcode [planwisewp]. Allow your website visitors, clients, or agents to draw floor plans effortlessly in their browser. As they draw, PlanWiseWP automatically calculates all crucial measurements in real-time. It’s the perfect B2B tool for real estate agencies, contractors, e-commerce stores (paint, flooring, furniture), and anyone who needs to provide accurate quotes or generate qualified leads.

From a simple utility to a powerful business and engineering engine

While the free version provides a powerful editor for your visitors, the PlanWiseWP PRO version transforms it into a complete professional asset. With PlanWiseWP PRO, your website can: * Handle Complex Geometries: Manage sophisticated architectural layouts with advanced Room Overlapping & Merging logic and intelligent snapping for non-standard shapes.
* Precision Dimensioning: Utilize Dynamic Guidelines and on-canvas dimension lines for millimeter-precise planning and professional-grade blueprints.
* Automate Engineering Quotes: Instantly calculate Net vs. Gross Floor Areas, Net Wall Surfaces (automatically subtracting all doors and windows), and Detailed Perimeters for accurate skirting or trim material estimation.
* Thermal & Volume Analysis: Automatically generate Air Volume data and estimated Heating Load requirements based on calculated surfaces and room volumes—perfect for HVAC and insulation contractors.
* Generate Qualified Leads: Allow users to Save & Load their plans, turning anonymous visitors into registered, contactable leads in your database.
* Strengthen Your Brand: Remove our watermark and add your own company logo to all exported high-resolution PNGs.
* Monetize Your Traffic: Use the Company Management panel to create premium, tiered access for your own B2B clients and partners.
* Full Data Portability: View user-saved plans (JSON) in the admin dashboard and unlock CSV & TXT export to sync data directly with your CRM or quoting software.

Core FREE features

  • Visual Snap-to-Grid editor: An intuitive drawing interface that’s easy for anyone to use.
  • Live basic calculations: Instantly calculates Gross Floor Area, Gross Wall Area, and item counts.
  • Smart magnetic alignment: Rooms and elements automatically snap together for perfect alignment.
  • Mobile & tablet ready: Fully responsive and touch-enabled.
  • Metric & Imperial units: Works seamlessly in (cm/m) or (in/ft).
  • Embed via shortcode: Place [planwisewp] on any page or post.
  • PNG image export: Lets users download a PNG of their plan (with PlanWiseWP watermark).
  • Admin customization: Control editor button colors and the preset room name list.
  • Translation ready: Fully translatable to your site’s language.

See the PRO vs. FREE Comparison | Try the Live DEMO | Read the Documentation

3rd Party or External Service Disclaimer

This plugin, when upgraded to the PRO version, uses the Freemius service (https://freemius.com) to handle licensing, payments, and automatic updates.
* Data Sent: When purchasing or activating a PRO license, user data (name, email, site URL, license key) is securely sent to Freemius to validate the purchase and manage the license.
* Freemius Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
Method 1: From your WordPress dashboard (Easiest)

  1. Navigate to ‘Plugins’ > ‘Add New’ in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Search for “PlanWiseWP”.
  3. Click ‘Install Now’, then click ‘Activate’.
  4. After activation, go to the new ‘PlanWiseWP’ menu in your admin sidebar to configure the settings.

Method 2: Manual upload via WordPress admin (from .zip)

  1. Download the planwisewp.zip file from the WordPress.org plugin directory.
  2. Navigate to ‘Plugins’ > ‘Add New’ in your WordPress admin.
  3. Click the ‘Upload Plugin’ button at the top of the page.
  4. Select the planwisewp.zip file you downloaded and click ‘Install Now’.
  5. Activate the plugin.

After activation:

  1. Navigate to the new PlanWiseWP > Settings menu in your admin sidebar. This is where you configure all core options:
    • Set the Unit System (Metric/Imperial).
    • Set the Free version default sizes for doors and windows.
    • Customize frontend Texts, Titles, and Tooltips.
  2. Place the [planwisewp] shortcode on any page or post to display the editor.
sections.faq:
How do I display the editor?

Just add the [planwisewp] shortcode to any WordPress page or post.

What are the essential initial settings?

Go to PlanWiseWP > Settings to set your Unit System (Metric/Imperial).

How do I align rooms or create shared walls?

Drag rooms close to each other, and they will magnetically snap together. The snapping logic uses the Wall Thickness value (set in the editor controls) to create a perfect gap, ready for placing shared doors or openings.

How do I select, move, or delete an element?

  • Select: Left-click (or tap) on a room or element.
  • Move: Click-and-drag (or touch-and-drag) the selected element.
  • Edit Panel: Right-click (or long-press on touch screens) a selected element to open the Edit Panel.
  • Rotate/Delete: Use the (↔️) and (🗑️) icons in the Edit Panel.

What is the difference between the Free and PRO export?

The Free version exports a PNG image with a “PlanWiseWP” watermark. The PRO version removes this watermark, lets you add your own logo, and adds data export options for .TXT and .CSV files.
